description.value: Hungry Bear is a casual restaurant in Fort St. John serving a mix of Asian dishes and burgers — an eclectic combination that makes it a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the Peace River region. It operates out of a single-storey retail building on 100 Avenue, one of the main commercial corridors in town.
